scope: Read-only Weave SDK agent_spans_query with include_details/include_costs, and read-only SQLite matching by answer ID. Existing records only; no model calls, backend mutation, replay or new paid scoring.

security_scan.scope: Complete returned span details scanned in memory; only counts are published. No new canary was submitted. This does not prove arbitrary secrets or PII cannot leak.

limits: This verifies recorded execution and costs for eight selected UI turns, not their factual accuracy or general reliability. See the independent manual answer reviews.

Native span input is gross including cache subsets; local provider input excludes those subsets. Estimates use returned Claude Sonnet 5.5 usage and the dated 2026-10-25 rates of $2/$10 per million uncached input/output, $2.50/$4 cache writes (5m/1h), and $0.10 cache reads.
Token-price estimates are not invoices. Excludes asynchronous Signals, hidden provider retries and usage never returned.
Readback preserves original records; it does not repair older traces or establish that a Signal fired.
Only configured secret values and common credential forms are checked; no new redaction canary was sent and arbitrary PII/encoding remains outside this check.
The source-check verdict sequence is checked for trace consistency, not endorsed as a quality score.
audit_method_note: The initial local checker incorrectly required the verifier to be a direct child of the turn. Source and backend inspection established the intended tree: turn -> submit_answer tool -> source_verifier -> model chat. Corrected that checker assumption and repeated read-only retrieval; no production span, local answer, or model result was changed.
